name: Grafana
description: Visualisez vos métriques avec de superbes dashboards.
compose:
services:
  grafana:
    image: grafana/grafana-oss:latest
    container_name: grafana
    restart: unless-stopped
    user: "{{PUID}}"
    ports:
      - "3003:3000"
    volumes:
      - {{APPDATA}}/data:/var/lib/grafana
